```python
# Python 3, standard library only.
# Signed literals are (predicate, subject, object, polarity).
def L(predicate, subject, obj="", positive=True):
    return (predicate, subject, obj, positive)

def opposite(literal):
    return literal[:-1] + (not literal[-1],)

animals = (
    "bee frog snake seahorse badger beaver ostrich dove woodpecker monkey "
    "swan rhino stork beetle goat ant vampire dragon dinosaur flamingo "
    "finch pigeon fangtooth bison dragonfly peafowl zebra"
).split()

facts = {
    L("card", "bee", "blue"),
    L("tears_down", "bee", "badger", False),
    L("card", "frog", "yellow"),
    L("has", "frog", "spinach"),
    L("reduced_hours", "snake"),
    L("creates_castle", "seahorse", "vampire", False),
}
# The source convention supplies only the color classification.
facts.update(L("primary_color", c) for c in ("red", "green", "blue"))
facts.add(L("leafy_green", "spinach"))

rules = []
def rule(number, body, head):
    rules.append((number, frozenset(body), head))

for x in animals:
    rule(1, [L("shouts", x, "beaver")], L("unites", x, "ostrich"))
    rule(2, [L("tears_down", x, "dove")],
         L("takes_over", "woodpecker", "monkey"))
    rule(3, [L("persuades", x, "rhino")],
         L("shouts", "swan", "beaver", False))
    rule(5, [L("tears_down", x, "badger", False)],
         L("refuses_help", x, "badger"))
    rule(6, [L("companionship", x, "ant")],
         L("shouts", "swan", "peafowl", False))
    rule(7, [L("unites", x, "ostrich")], L("trades", "beetle", "stork"))
    rule(8, [L("creates_castle", x, "dragon")],
         L("refuses_help", x, "dinosaur"))
    rule(10, [L("wants", x, "goat")],
         L("captures", "finch", "pigeon", False))
    rule(12, [L("creates_castle", x, "vampire", False)],
         L("companionship", x, "ant"))
    rule(13, [L("takes_over", x, "monkey")],
         L("refuses_help", "bee", "dinosaur", False))
    rule(14, [L("wants", x, "fangtooth")],
         L("shouts", x, "beetle", False))
    rule(15, [L("trades", x, "bison")],
         L("unites", "swan", "ostrich", False))
    rule(17, [L("refuses_help", x, "dinosaur", False)],
         L("reveals_secret", x, "zebra"))
    rule(18, [L("shouts", x, "beetle", False),
              L("reveals_secret", x, "zebra")],
         L("trades", x, "stork", False))
    rule(19, [L("refuses_help", x, "badger")],
         L("shouts", x, "dragonfly"))
    rule(20, [L("shouts", x, "dragonfly")], L("wants", x, "fangtooth"))
    rule(22, [L("shouts", x, "peafowl")], L("shouts", x, "beaver"))

rule(4, [L("trades", "bee", "stork", False),
         L("trades", "beetle", "stork")], L("wants", "stork", "goat"))
rule(9, [L("smiles", "flamingo", "bee")], L("shouts", "bee", "beetle"))
rule(11, [L("less_than_four", "frog")],
     L("destroys_wall", "frog", "swan", False))
for color in ("red", "green", "blue", "yellow"):
    rule(16, [L("card", "frog", color), L("primary_color", color)],
         L("destroys_wall", "frog", "swan", False))
rule(21, [L("has", "frog", "spinach"), L("leafy_green", "spinach")],
     L("destroys_wall", "frog", "swan"))
rule(23, [L("reduced_hours", "snake")], L("tears_down", "snake", "dove"))
rule(24, [L("destroys_wall", "frog", "swan")],
     L("shouts", "swan", "peafowl"))

preferred = {
    (11, 21), (15, 1), (16, 21), (24, 6),
    (3, 22), (8, 13), (9, 14),
}

def infer(current):
    applicable = [r for r in rules if r[1] <= current]
    result = set(facts)
    for number, body, head in applicable:
        defeated = any(
            (higher, number) in preferred and higher_head == opposite(head)
            for higher, higher_body, higher_head in applicable
        )
        if not defeated:
            result.add(head)
    return result

state = set(facts)
seen = set()
settled = False
for _ in range(1000):
    key = frozenset(state)
    if key in seen:
        break
    seen.add(key)
    new_state = infer(state)
    if new_state == state:
        settled = True
        break
    state = new_state

if not settled:
    print("UNSUPPORTED: inference did not reach a stable fixed point")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
else:
    positive = L("captures", "finch", "pigeon") in state
    negative = L("captures", "finch", "pigeon", False) in state
    print("Finch captures pigeon king:", positive)
    print("Finch does not capture pigeon king:", negative)
    print("Stork wants to see goat:", L("wants", "stork", "goat") in state)
    if positive and negative:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: unresolved contradictory target conclusions")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
    else:
        expected = "proved" if positive else "disproved" if negative else "unknown"
        print("Computed answer:", expected)
        print("Submitted answer: disproved")
        print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "disproved" else "CHECK FAIL")
```
